title: Chinese Retail Chains
description:
I examined announcements, press releases, and social media posts from selected leading Chinese companies to build a database tracking the number of new stores and their locations. It's an unstoppable trend: Chinese retail chains are opening brick-and-mortar locations across the US. I found that in New York City alone, 20 Chinese retail chains have opened more than 40 stores across the food, beverage, and fashion sectors over the past two years.

I also compared them with their international rivals—including Starbucks, Lego, MUJI, and ZARA—on revenue and store count, highlighting the challenges these companies face in competing with the new entrants.

title: BYD Deep Ocean Shipping
description:
BYD, the Chinese EV company, is quietly building an armada of giant car-carrying cargo ships to transport its electric vehicles overseas.

I conducted an analysis by examining AIS data provided by Marine Traffic, which includes details like Port Call Type, Port at Call, Time at Call, Load Condition, and other useful variables to help verify which countries the ships stopped in. I then cross-referenced each trip with Chinese media coverage to verify completeness. I used an interactive map to show how BYD has increased its electric vehicle exports to European countries and continuously expanded its reach over three years.

title: US Data Center Risk
description:
This project was a year-long investigation with around 40 reporters and editors examining the explosive growth of the data center industry. Our reporting found 1,240 data centers in the US either already built or approved for construction by the end of 2024.

I contributed all static graphics for this series and conducted analysis to create a repeatable-use public health costs map using Mapbox GL. After publishing, I worked with my editor to produce an interactive tool to help readers look up these 1,240 data centers.

title: Option Opportunism
description: I created this scroll-based line chart to show changes in S&P 500 stock prices before and after CEO grant dates. The charts reveal a clear V trend, suggesting that firms opportunistically inflated their valuations around these dates.

title: Gen Z slow road
description: A reporter observed that Gen Z appears to be living life at a slower pace—launching careers later, delaying marriage, and postponing milestones. I used the Current Population Survey through IPUMS to support this trend, finding significant declines in both the percentage of Americans married by age 24 and the share of 24-year-olds with children. I visualized the data in Datawrapper and conducted analysis in R.

title: China Renewable Energy Bet
description: I collaborated with Foreign Desk on this ambitious series, also my first print byline at WaPo. We analyzed 15+ hard-to-get datasets, created 12 graphics (including a companion piece on EVs), reviewed dozens of academic papers and research reports, and interviewed industry experts to examine China's dominance across every aspect of clean energy. The series was widely cited by nonprofits, research institutions, and international media outlets.
